symptom: A material delivery could end user-facing at a pending state such as gates running, auto-merge armed or remaining borging steps, leaving the user unsure what had to happen next.
root_cause: The existing no-pending terminal rule prohibited several pending statuses but did not make Dashboard/System Map registration and a fixed no-open-end user handoff explicit terminal writebacks.
fix: Keep delivery ownership with the originating/recovering node until terminal proof.
Require canonical current-state/activity, learning/prevention, skill projection and Powerhouse Dashboard/System Map writeback before terminal green.
Normal user handoff reports only proven/borged results; autonomous follow-up is not delegated back to the user.
Only BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY may return one smallest human action while preserving the prepared continuation.
prevention: Every future material chat/agent inherits the terminal user handoff contract through powerhouse-continuity.
A user should not need to say 'ga door' after a non-terminal interruption.
Dashboard/System Map registration is a Definition-of-Done gate, not optional documentation.
